Real signal told apart from noise and from a coordinated campaign: adverse media scored for strength, coherence and manipulation, with early warning when the narrative shifts. Defensive only.

The concept behind it: [Reputation risk](@/glossary/reputation-risk.md).

Services that draw on it: [Digital forensics and evidence preservation](@/services/digital-forensics.md) and [Reputation intelligence and adverse-media monitoring](@/services/reputation-intelligence.md).

Practised with: [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [GitHub Actions](@/glossary/github-actions.md), [GitHub Pages](@/glossary/github-pages.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [jq](@/glossary/jq.md), [Just](@/glossary/just.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md) and [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md).

Public work whose own words show it: [osint-case-ratcliffe-moscow-2026](https://github.com/korczis/osint-case-ratcliffe-moscow-2026).
